winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一

briefs.speaker: Adam Gold
briefs.speaker_context: Chief Investment Officer at an investment advisory firm (referred to as Katam Hill)
briefs.current_title: 资管CIO Adam Gold：AI交易为何周末前波动加剧？

subtitles.zh: 早上好，希望你一切顺利。你的预测是什么？为什么进入这个周末市场如此紧张？
subtitles.en: Good morning, and trust you're well. What's your prognosis? Why are markets so edgy going into this weekend?

subtitles.zh: 嗯，我们有很多不确定性，当问题无法回答时，市场参与者不喜欢这样。
subtitles.en: Well, we've had a lot of uncertainty, and investors don't like when questions can't be answered.

subtitles.zh: 所以我们对中期选举有很多担忧。
subtitles.en: So we had a lot of concern into the midterms.

subtitles.zh: 出现了蓝色浪潮，有点让人震惊。
subtitles.en: There was a blue tsunami, a little bit shocking to people.

subtitles.zh: 这引发了关于更多数据中心礼堂将会发生什么的疑问。
subtitles.en: That raises questions about what's going to happen in more auditoriums for data centers.

subtitles.zh: 而人工智能交易会有很多相关性。
subtitles.en: And the AI trade would have had a lot of correlation.

subtitles.zh: 这些都类似。七月期间大幅下跌，然后大幅反弹。
subtitles.en: That was all similar. There was a big drop in the July period, a big rebound.

subtitles.zh: 只是一波波的主题。软件某天下跌，半导体上涨，反之亦然。
subtitles.en: There have been just sort of waves and themes. Software is down one day, semis are up, and vice versa.

subtitles.zh: 所以有很多群体思维。不幸的是，这正在瓦解，因为一位有史以来最伟大的创始人离开了他经营的公司。
subtitles.en: So there's just a lot of a lot of groupthink. And unfortunately, this is unwinding because one of the greatest founders of all time has left the company that he ran.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为这给目前的看跌理由增添了额外的动力。
subtitles.en: So I think this has caused an extra, an extra dynamite in this bear case for the moment.

subtitles.zh: 但我认为最终会有解决方案。不过目前，我们对这些问题还没有太多答案。
subtitles.en: But I think there will be a resolution at some point. But at the moment, we don't have a lot of answers to these questions.

subtitles.zh: 即便在大型首秀中，我也无法忽视它。
subtitles.en: And even in a big debut, I can't drop it.

subtitles.zh: 不足以重振整个AI交易，亚当。
subtitles.en: Wasn't enough to revive this whole AI trade, Adam.

briefs.current_title: 资管CIO Adam Gold：万亿IPO首日，普通配置者该追吗？

subtitles.zh: 这次IPO能算成功吗？对员工、创始人、风投来说，
subtitles.en: Can we call this IPO a success? A success for the employees, for the founders, and for the venture capitalists,

subtitles.zh: 以及对冲基金或共同基金，他们让这家公司从零市值到上市首日近2万亿美元，
subtitles.en: and the hedge funds or mutual funds who've taken this company from $0 in value to almost $2 trillion on day one,

subtitles.zh: 对其他没机会买入的市场参与者来说，不幸的是他们得等到IPO之后。
subtitles.en: unfortunate part for all the other investors who didn't have a chance to buy it, is they have to wait until this IPO comes out.

subtitles.zh: 这是过去十年私募市场的一个不幸之处。
subtitles.en: And this is an unfortunate part of the private markets in the last decade.

subtitles.zh: 我认为这些公司应该更早上市，SpaceX也是如此。
subtitles.en: These companies, I believe, should have been public much earlier, same thing for SpaceX for this.

subtitles.zh: 这样你才能真正有机会与所有市场参与者、人们的退休账户分享这些收益。
subtitles.en: And you have really got a chance to share those gains with all investors, people's retirement accounts.

briefs.speaker: Adam Gold
briefs.speaker_context: Chief Investment Officer at an investment advisory firm (referred to as Katam Hill)
briefs.current_title: 资管CIO Adam Gold：IPO首日不碰，等锁定期后再看

subtitles.zh: 或者要等多久？你的领先指标是什么，判断是否适合入场？
subtitles.en: Or how long would one wait? What would be your leading indicators, whether or not it is a good time to get into?

subtitles.zh: 举个例子，像Anthropic这样的名字，以及这次大规模亮相。
subtitles.en: That's an example, a name like anthropic, and this massive debut.

subtitles.zh: 当然，我从18岁起就专业从事这个行业。
subtitles.en: Sure, I've been doing this since I was 18 years old professionally.

subtitles.zh: 我现在43岁，有三个年幼的孩子。我在IPO上吸取了教训。
subtitles.en: I'm 43 now, I have three young children. And I've learned my lesson on IPOs.

subtitles.zh: 你要等到锁定期结束。锁定期会有分阶段释放，因为这里会像SpaceX那样分阶段进行。
subtitles.en: You wait until the lockups expire. There's explorations on lockups happen, because they're going to be more staged here like they were with SpaceX.

subtitles.zh: 我们不必精确等到180天，但你肯定想等到更多份额可用。
subtitles.en: We don't have to wait exactly till 180 days, but you certainly want to wait till more shares are available.

subtitles.zh: 私募市场是单边的。谁出价最高获得租赁所有权，就是谁。
subtitles.en: Private markets are one sided. It's whoever gives them the most money for the lease ownership.

subtitles.zh: 那等于报价估值。而这显然不真实。
subtitles.en: That equals the quote valuation. And that's clearly not true.

subtitles.zh: 估值基于双边市场，买方和卖方。
subtitles.en: A valuation is based upon two sided markets, buyers and sellers.

subtitles.zh: 所以我们不喜欢第一天就买入。我们很有耐心。
subtitles.en: So we don't like to buy on day one. We have a lot of patience.

subtitles.zh: 我们会等几个月，等到几次财报电话会议之后。
subtitles.en: We'll wait a few months. We'll wait till there's a few earnings calls.

subtitles.zh: 我们会看他们如何指引，看市场如何反应。
subtitles.en: We'll see how they guide. We'll see how the stock reacts.

subtitles.zh: 但我们不喜欢凭第一天的表现判断公司。
subtitles.en: But we don't like to judge companies on day one investments.

subtitles.zh: 我们喜欢以第十年的眼光判断，因此持有周期长达数十年。
subtitles.en: We like to judge them on year 10. And so we have a multi decade year holding period.

subtitles.zh: 那些是我们最青睐的公司，就像视频里的苹果。
subtitles.en: Those are our favorite companies, the ones like Apple on the video.

subtitles.zh: 我们持有这些公司已超过几十年，目标是继续寻找优质权益资产。
subtitles.en: We've owned those for over decades now. And our goal is to kind of continue to look for great investments.

subtitles.zh: 我们认为Anthropic未来可能成为一家伟大的复利型公司。
subtitles.en: We think anthropic might be a great compounding company in the future.

subtitles.zh: 有很多问题需要找到答案，但你知道，第一天就两万亿美元。
subtitles.en: There's a lot of questions that we'll have to get answers to. But you know, two trillion dollars on day one.

subtitles.zh: 我们对那种配置不感兴趣。
subtitles.en: We're not interested in that kind of investment.

subtitles.zh: 你提到你们持有某视频公司已有一段时间。
subtitles.en: You mentioned you've been holders of a video for some time now.

briefs.speaker: Adam Gold
briefs.speaker_context: Chief Investment Officer at an investment advisory firm (referred to as Katam Hill)
briefs.current_title: 资管CIO Adam Gold：AI龙头回调40%，为何仍不急于加仓？

subtitles.zh: 你提到你们持有某视频公司已有一段时间。在Jensen Wang相关事件后，你们是否调整了配置或敞口？
subtitles.en: You mentioned you've been holders of a video for some time now. Have you changed your allocation or your exposure to the stock since the fallout around Jensen Wang?

subtitles.zh: 是的，我们是长期持有者，自2016年起就相信AI。
subtitles.en: Yeah, we're very long term holders and believers in AI in 2016.

subtitles.zh: 当我在会议上遇到Jensen时，我问了他们关于AI的潜力。
subtitles.en: When I met Jensen at a conference, did I ask them about the potential of AI?

subtitles.zh: 以及半导体，那些将处理这种智能的机器。
subtitles.en: And the semiconductor, the machines that are going to process this intelligence.

subtitles.zh: 我们做了类比。我和他谈了PC时代的英特尔或超级计算时代的IBM。
subtitles.en: We made the analogy. I talked to him about Intel on the PC side or IBM on the super computing side.

subtitles.zh: 我们认为，实际上AI的潜力会比所有这些都大。
subtitles.en: And we thought, but actually AI would have bigger potential than all of that.

subtitles.zh: 因此，引领这场革命的公司可能成为世界上最大的公司。
subtitles.en: And so the company that would leave that revolution might be the biggest company in the world.

subtitles.zh: 这是在2016年，当时市值400亿美元。
subtitles.en: This has been in 2016 when it was a $40 billion market cap.

subtitles.zh: 当时它每季度总收入约10亿美元，全公司40亿美元。
subtitles.en: And at the time it was doing about a billion dollars quarter in total revenue, $4 billion for the whole company.

subtitles.zh: 目前营收运行率是4300亿美元。
subtitles.en: It's currently $430 billion revenue run rate.

subtitles.zh: 所以这些数字令人难以置信。实际上，没有人见过如此规模的公司以这样的速度增长。
subtitles.en: So the numbers are incredible. It's actually some no one's ever seen a company of this size grow at this pace.

subtitles.zh: 所以现在它的市盈率只有中个位数。
subtitles.en: So now it's trading at mid single digit PE multiple.

subtitles.zh: 你知道，所以它已经从高点下跌了40%。
subtitles.en: You know, so it's come down 40% from its high.

subtitles.zh: 你想想他们刚刚实现的70%、100%以上的营收增长率。
subtitles.en: And you think about the growth rate of 70, 100% plus revenue growth they just had.

subtitles.zh: 首席财务官现在以首席执行官的身份指引明年至少增长75%。
subtitles.en: The CFO now in terms CEO has guided to at least 75% next year.

subtitles.zh: 这是非常显著的增长。我认为，在回答你的问题之前，自2016年以来，我们已经总共减少了约75%的仓位。
subtitles.en: This is just remarkable growth. And I think until we have answers now to your question, over time since 2016, we've reduced our position by about 75% in total.

subtitles.zh: 由于复利效应，它仍然成长为我们的最大持仓。
subtitles.en: It still has grown to become our largest position in size just because of the compounding.

subtitles.zh: 但我们希望适时增持。
subtitles.en: But we would like to buy more of it in time.

subtitles.zh: 我们只需等待其中一些问题得到解答。我认为几周后的国会和参议院听证会将会很重要。
subtitles.en: We just have to wait for some of these questions to get answered. I think the congressional and Senate testimony in a few weeks will be important.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.

KC评论：但他补了一句，希望适时增持。

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

Title and display rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Use exactly three non-empty title lines, each a punchy cover block. Ideal lengths: 3-10, 4-12, 5-14 Chinese characters.
- Full title should be short and sharp, ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- Keep only one core conflict. Do not pack background, claim, caveat, and conclusion into one line.
- Highlights must be exact substrings of joined title_lines and emphasize the actor, number, reversal, China advantage, or tension.
- Do not use flat endings such as 回报路径在哪、回报存疑、前景如何、未来如何、有待观察、仍不明朗、面临挑战、带来机遇、释放信号、关键分叉在哪、有望扩大. Turn the caveat into a concrete unresolved action or contradiction.
- Every line must be a complete Chinese phrase. Do not leave a transitive tension verb such as 逼急、逼到、迫使 or 倒逼 without its subject or object.
- Do not use source badges, emojis, markdown, quotation marks, hashtags, or numbering.
- Title fields must not contain 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出.

- Do not mention sensitive geopolitical or military topics.

- comment starts with KC评论： and adds context, consequence, or the next fact to watch in 16-34 Chinese characters. Do not repeat the title.
- subtitle_comments contains one item for every input subtitle index, grounded in that exact subtitle rather than a generic clip slogan.

subtitles.en: No, not agnostic at all. You need to find someone extremely technically capable.

briefs.speaker: Winston Chang
briefs.speaker_context: CFO, Lenovo
briefs.current_title: 联想CFO温斯顿：账面亏损19亿美元，核心业务为何反而更强？
current_title_lines: 核心业务为何反而更强？

subtitles.zh: 我们连线到了首席财务官Winston Chang，请他为我们解读这些数字，谈谈是什么导致了营业亏损或转为亏损。
subtitles.en: is a record joining us now. Of course, we have the CFO, Winston Chang. To walk us through these numbers, tell us about what drove that operating loss or what swung to a loss in some ways.

subtitles.zh: 这些是会计处理问题。目前市场对PC组件成本持续上升有些担忧。
subtitles.en: I mean, these are some counting issues. There are some concerns now about the PC component costs that are continued to store as well.

subtitles.zh: 这并不新鲜，很大程度上是由认股权证重估驱动的。
subtitles.en: Well, this is nothing new. This is really largely driven by the war and revaluation.

subtitles.zh: 在第三季度末，即自然年第三季度、但财年第二季度9月30日，股价非常高。
subtitles.en: At the end of a third quarter, a third quarter calendar year, but second quarter, September 30th, the stock price was very, very high.

subtitles.zh: 因此，按会计准则，认股权证重估产生了亏损。
subtitles.en: And therefore, the accounting war and valuation was a loss in terms of accounting standard.

subtitles.zh: 这笔调整达19亿美元。
subtitles.en: And that was a $1.9 billion adjustment.

subtitles.zh: 所以调整后，实际利润为14亿美元。
subtitles.en: So adjust the basis were actually $1.4 billion US dollars in terms of profits.

subtitles.zh: 营收同比增长48%，但各项利润——毛利润、营业利润——
subtitles.en: So revenue grew 48% year on year, but actually profit in every line of profit, growth profit, operating profit,

subtitles.zh: 以及净利润的增长都远快于营收增长。
subtitles.en: and net income profit grew much faster than revenue growth.

subtitles.zh: 这正是我们的目标。剔除所有复杂的会计处理，核心业务表现良好。
subtitles.en: And that's been our goal in terms of our target. So the core business is doing well when you strip out all the fancy accounting stuff.

briefs.speaker_context: CFO, Lenovo
briefs.current_title: 联想CFO温斯顿：全年营收目标1000亿美元，上半年已超500亿

subtitles.zh: 撇开那些花哨的会计处理。相对而言，你们财年已过六个月，收入方面距离全年目标进展如何？
subtitles.en: out all the fancy accounting stuff. Relative to, so you're six months into your fiscal year, where are you relative to your full-year target as far as revenue goes?

subtitles.zh: 是的，我们有一个全年目标，嗯，我认为是两年目标超过1000亿美元。
subtitles.en: Yeah, we have a full-year target of, well, I think a two-year target of over $100 billion.

subtitles.zh: 今年上半年我们已经完成了超过500亿美元。
subtitles.en: We've already done greater than $50 billion in the first half of this year.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为我们正稳步推进该目标，而且本财年很可能超过1000亿美元的目标。
subtitles.en: So I think we're well on track of that goal and it's very likely that we'll exceed that goal of $100 billion in this current fiscal year.

subtitles.zh: 好的。好的。我是不是可以理解为你们可能需要上调指引？
subtitles.en: Okay. Okay. Do I sense that you'll need to maybe up, you know, raise it?

subtitles.zh: 现在上调指引？1000亿美元。
subtitles.en: Upgrade your guidance now? $100 billion.

subtitles.zh: 到什么时候你们会觉得，嗯，那将是轻而易举的事？
subtitles.en: At what point does it make sense for you to go, you know, that's going to be easy work now?

subtitles.zh: 嗯，内部来看，我们的基础设施业务同比增长了175%。
subtitles.en: Well, internally, you'll see that our infrastructure business grew 175% year on year.

subtitles.zh: 因此，鉴于全球计算需求依然强劲，该业务继续展现出强劲势头。
subtitles.en: And so that business continues to show a lot of strength, given that the global demand for compute remains robust.

subtitles.zh: 因此，基于这一点，我们实际上已经在内部上调了ISG业务的目标。
subtitles.en: And so on that basis, we've actually already internally adjust the target up for the ISG business.

subtitles.zh: 就PC市场持续的压力而言，您认为内存价格何时会见顶？您是否看到任何
subtitles.en: Yeah. In terms of just the ongoing PC headwinds, I mean, when do you think we're going to see, I mean, a cap when it comes to memory prices and then like, I mean, do you see anything

subtitles.en: that could change the numbers in any way for you?

subtitles.zh: 对于PC业务？PC业务，我认为市场已经预期了大概超过六个月。

subtitles.zh: 将导致销量下降。随着成本开始进入渠道，您开始看到这在市场中成为现实。
subtitles.en: that the volume will come down. And you're starting to see that come into fruition in the market as costs started coming into the channel.

subtitles.zh: 从设备业务的角度来看，我认为这可能会持续两到三个季度。
subtitles.en: And I think that will probably persist over the next two to three quarters from the device business perspective.

subtitles.zh: 是的，从设备业务的角度来看。对于组件成本。是的。
subtitles.en: Yeah, from the device business perspective. For component costs. Yeah.

subtitles.zh: 我们再谈一点。我们最喜欢的话题之一。是的，当然，当然。
subtitles.en: We talk a little bit more about that. One of our favorite topics. Yeah, of course, of course.

subtitles.zh: 但我认为我们在基础设施方面都受益，当然，有供应也有强劲需求。
subtitles.en: But I think we're getting benefits from both on the infrastructure side, of course, having the supply but with a strong demand.

subtitles.zh: 更高的成本确实是由业务基础设施方面的全球计算需求驱动的。
subtitles.en: The higher cost is really driven by the global compute on the infrastructure side of the business.

subtitles.zh: 我们在该领域拥有最优质的业务之一。
subtitles.en: And we have one of the best business in that area.

subtitles.zh: 对吧？我们的ISG业务在上季度成为X86服务器第一大供应商。
subtitles.en: Right? Our ISG business, we become the number one X86 server provider this last quarter.

subtitles.zh: 因此从这个角度看，我们拥有全球布局，且该业务收入实现三位数增长。
subtitles.en: So I think from that perspective, we are global footprint and our business growing in triple digits in terms of that revenue growth.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为该业务领域需求非常强劲。
subtitles.en: So I think a very strong demand in that side of the business.

subtitles.zh: 这很大程度上抵消了销量方面的下滑。
subtitles.en: More than more offsets that decline in terms of volume.

Use the research guide as a hard boundary: unsupported surprise, dishonesty, holdings, public actions, and national comparisons are forbidden. Wording guard for all Chinese output:

- china_advantage: use only when research.china_advantage.supported is true. Put the concrete Chinese advantage or the foreign competitor's forced response in the foreground. The emotional direction must favor China.
- authority_breaks_consensus: the authority must be recognizable to a China audience, or be labeled by a meaningful role. Do not lead with an obscure romanized name.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

briefs.speaker: Winston Chang
briefs.speaker_context: CFO, Lenovo
briefs.current_title: 联想CFO温斯顿：芯片管制与AI发展，清晰规则反而利好合规企业
current_title_lines: 清晰规则反而利好合规企业

subtitles.zh: 在PC业务方面，Vidya是你们的供应商之一。我想知道，我们从黄仁勋那里看到的任何后果是否会影响你们的业务？
subtitles.en: in terms of the PC business. And Vidya is one of your suppliers. I'm just wondering, has any of the fallout we've seen from Jensen Huang impact that your business is anyway?

subtitles.zh: 本周我们看到了阿里巴巴等公司的财报。
subtitles.en: We had the likes of Alibaba 10 Cent this week and their earnings.

subtitles.zh: 谈论这些美国的新芯片限制可能会减缓AI发展，并影响中国的AI发展。
subtitles.en: Talk about these new chip curves in the US may actually slow down the AI development and affect AI development in China.

subtitles.zh: 你对此有何看法？我会从几个方面来分析。
subtitles.en: What's your take on all this? Well, I'll break it down into a couple of areas.

subtitles.zh: 一是全球对算力的需求。我认为这基本上没有改变。
subtitles.en: One is the global demand for compute. And I think that is very much intact.

subtitles.zh: Vidya的技术是市场上最好的之一。我认为它和其他供应商一样，在市场上仍有强劲需求。
subtitles.en: And Vidya's technology is one of the best in the market. I think that still has a strong demand in the market as with other suppliers.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为市场份额和其他方面在过去几周内没有变化。
subtitles.en: So I think there's a market share and other things have not changed in the course of last couple weeks.

subtitles.zh: 所以需求持续存在。就出现的其他复杂情况而言，我认为明确的监管实际上会更好
subtitles.en: So that demand continues. In terms of the other complexities that come out, I think clear regulations will actually be better

subtitles.zh: 从长远来看对市场更好，因为它实际上释放了资本，让有明确规则的人能够以合规的方式提供算力。
subtitles.en: for the market in the long run, because it actually frees up capital and allows people with clear rules to be able to provide compute in a compliant way.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为这实际上对我们这样非常合规的公司有帮助，但我们实际上不参与其他类型的交易。
subtitles.en: So I think it actually helps companies like us when we are very compliant, but we in fact don't get into other type of transactions.

subtitles.zh: 但规则明确时，我们就能通过运营方式合规。
subtitles.en: But when there's clear rules, then it complies through the way we operate.

subtitles.zh: 这对我们更有利。我认为这实际上释放了资本，因为许多银行也合规。
subtitles.en: It's even better for us. And I think that actually frees up capital, because a lot of banks are also compliant.

subtitles.zh: 因此，清晰度提高后，我认为资本得以释放，他们能向市场提供更多资金。
subtitles.en: So with clarity, I think the capital gets freed up in terms of what they can actually provide to the market.

subtitles.zh: 这是市场今天需要的。所以市场不仅在零部件方面受限，在资本方面也受限。
subtitles.en: That the market needs today. So not only the market is constrained in terms of components, but also constrained in terms of capital today.

subtitles.zh: 这些资本的成本正在重估，他们试图找到合适的资本成本。
subtitles.en: And that capital has a repricing in terms of that cost and they are trying to find the right cost of that capital.

subtitles.zh: 同时也在监管方面。
subtitles.en: But also in terms of the regulatory aspect.

subtitles.zh: 因此，清晰度提高后，我认为这也会释放资本配置。
subtitles.en: So with clarity, I think that will also frees up the capital deployment.

briefs.speaker: Winston Chang
briefs.speaker_context: CFO, Lenovo
briefs.current_title: 联想CFO温斯顿：AI算力需求旺盛，2028年资本开支还会增长吗？

subtitles.zh: 服务器业务也可以再谈。因为很多人正在重新思考，我不确定行业预期是否准确，有多少资本支出投入其中。
subtitles.en: On the server business, we can go back to that as well. Because lots of people are rethinking, and I'm not sure if it's accurate on industry braces, how much catbex is going into this.

subtitles.zh: 从你的角度看，未来几年的增长态势如何？
subtitles.en: What are you seeing from your perspective in terms of just the build-up going into the next couple of years?

subtitles.zh: 是的。很多人在争论2028年的资本支出会怎样，因为超大规模企业的资本支出是争论焦点。
subtitles.en: Yeah. A lot of people are debating what will be the catbex in 2028 because the hyperscalers catbex is the debate

subtitles.zh: 2027年的情况很明确。我认为有很多讨论认为2028年仍将比2027年增长。
subtitles.en: and very clear in terms of 2027. I think there's a lot of discussions that that 2028 is still going to be an increase from 2027.

subtitles.zh: 好的。我们还看到下一梯队，不仅是你看到的美国或中国的超大规模企业。
subtitles.en: Okay. Well, we're also seeing in terms of the next tier, not only the hyperscalers that you see from the US or from China.

subtitles.zh: 你还看到下一级别的大型、超大型互联网公司，市值达数百亿美元。
subtitles.en: You're also seeing kind of the next level of large, very large internet companies in the double-digit billion market cap size.

subtitles.zh: 这类公司，可能不是万亿美元级别的，而是几千亿美元。
subtitles.en: That type of companies, and maybe not the trillion-dollar ones, but a couple hundred billion.

subtitles.zh: 规模足够大，他们也在部署，也在寻找计算空间和计算能力。
subtitles.en: Big enough that they are also deploying, and they're also looking for compute space and compute power.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为从这个角度看，你确实看到了健康的景象。
subtitles.en: So I think from that perspective, you were really seeing a healthy optic.

briefs.speaker: Winnie
briefs.speaker_context: Head of APAC Equity Strategy, BofA Global Research
briefs.current_title: 美银Winnie：AI基建2026会重演光伏2022？出口双杀风险浮现

subtitles.zh: 当需求放缓时，产能仍在上线，这不仅是量的问题，也是均价的问题。
subtitles.en: Right, when the demand is slowing, well, cat-pack is still coming online, then it's not only a volume problem, it's also ASP problem.

subtitles.zh: 所以出口商可能面临双重打击：潜在的量放缓，以及定价压力。
subtitles.en: So, you know, exporters could start to face the double hit from both the outlook on potential volume slowdown, but it is also the pricing.

subtitles.zh: 国内最悲观的类比是，2026年的AI基础设施可能像2022年的光伏。
subtitles.en: So, domestically, the most bearish analogy is that AI infrastructure in 2026 might look like a solar trade in 2022.

subtitles.zh: 这是最极端的空头情景，对吧？
subtitles.en: Which is the ultimate bear case, right?

subtitles.zh: 所以出口实际上面临很多不确定性。
subtitles.en: So, export actually faced a lot of uncertainty.

subtitles.zh: 挑战在于，未来几个季度的盈利可能看起来还行，对吧？
subtitles.en: The challenges, next few quarters earning, might still look okay, right?

subtitles.zh: 如果看三四个季度，可能还行，但人们已经开始下调估值倍数，
subtitles.en: If you look at the three quarters, four quarters, might still be okay, but people already start to devalue the rate on the multiples,

subtitles.zh: 对某些板块来说，很难找到估值倍数的锚，比如我们之前讨论的存储。
subtitles.en: and for some of the sectors, it's really hard to find an anchor on the valuation multiple, like, you know, memory as we discussed before.

subtitles.zh: 你认为这更多是估值重估，还是基本面也出现了问题？
subtitles.en: Do you think this is more of a valuation reset, or do you think fundamentally there is something that is breaking down now, too?

briefs.speaker: Winnie
briefs.speaker_context: Head of APAC Equity Strategy, BofA Global Research
briefs.current_title: 美银Winnie：估值重估还是基本面破位？资金转向防御与下游

subtitles.zh: 你认为这更像是估值重估，还是基本面也出现了问题？
subtitles.en: Do you think this is more of a valuation reset, or do you think fundamentally there is something that is breaking down now, too?

subtitles.zh: 我认为两者都有。目前估值可能更多反映长期，而非下季度，
subtitles.en: I think it's both, right? As of now, valuation is reflecting probably more of the longer term, not next quarter,

subtitles.zh: 而是两到三年的大周期问题。
subtitles.en: but it's the two, three-year larger cycle question.

subtitles.zh: 因此，内需更大的市场，出口依赖较低，如日本、中国、印度，结构上更具优势，
subtitles.en: So, that's why we will say markets with a bigger domestic economy, less rely on export, you know, so the larger market, like, you know, Japan, China, India are structurally better position,

subtitles.zh: 至少有国内消费、金融板块和其他板块可布局，比如医疗保健，对吧？
subtitles.en: at least there's domestic consumption, there's financial sector, there's other sectors to play with, a health care, right?

subtitles.zh: 其次，总体而言我们倾向于防御，对吧？
subtitles.en: Second, I think generally we want to play defensive, right?

subtitles.zh: 因此，股息率高的权益资产很重要，某种程度上这就是为什么中国银行股现在成为共识增持，大家都喜欢，
subtitles.en: So, the dividend yield stocks are important, and to some extent that's why China banks are now, like, the consensus overweight, everyone loves China banks now,

subtitles.zh: 正如我们之前讨论的，不仅是股息率本身，还有每股股息的确定性，对吧？
subtitles.en: and as we discussed before, it's not only the dividend yield itself, but it's also the certainty of the DPS, right?

subtitles.zh: 银行股的优势在于其盈利确定性非常高。
subtitles.en: And the beauty of the banks has been that their earnings certainty is very, very high.

subtitles.zh: 因此，贝塔值低，防御性也很重要。
subtitles.en: So, beta is low, so the defensive part is also very important.

subtitles.zh: 但第三个要素，我认为人们正在考虑的是上游与下游的对比。
subtitles.en: But also, the third element, I think people are considering, is the upstream versus downstream.

subtitles.zh: 过去两三年，交易策略是围绕卖铲子的地方，对吧？
subtitles.en: All right, for the past two, three years, the trade is by the pick and shovel place, right?

subtitles.zh: 围绕上游基础设施，因为无论哪种模式胜出，他们都需要更多存储、更多冷却、更多PCB。
subtitles.en: By the upstream infrastructure, because regardless which model wins, they will need more memories, they will need more cooling, they will need more PCBs.

subtitles.zh: 但现在，担忧在于上游模式，其中一些可能终究没那么高，而且某些领域存在中国竞争，
subtitles.en: But now, the fear is that upstream, the mode, some of them might not be that high after all, and there's the Chinese competition in some of the sectors,

subtitles.zh: 产能已经建好，而大家一直低配一些下游，对吧？
subtitles.en: there's the capacity built out, whereas everyone has been underweight some of the downstream, right?

subtitles.zh: 从消费电子到应用类公司，所以也许人们正在寻求再平衡，对吧？
subtitles.en: Ranging from consumer electronics to the application names, so maybe people are looking to rebalance, right?

subtitles.zh: 中和上游基础设施的升级，并重新评估下游的故事。
subtitles.en: Neutralize the upgrade on the upstream infrastructure and looking to re-evaluate the downstream stories.

subtitles.zh: 问题是，如你所知，人们正试图弄清楚2028年的盈利情况。
subtitles.en: The issue is, as you know, people are trying to figure out what 20-28 earnings looks like.

subtitles.zh: 如果更关注中国内地市场，是聚焦问题，还是坚持内地市场，或者认为香港市场在AI方面更多元？
subtitles.en: If I look more at my own market in China, do I focus on issues then? Stick to A, or do you think there's more of that diversification of AI in Hong Kong?

subtitles.zh: 亚洲在AI方面，之前我们说过有三类，对吧？
subtitles.en: So, Asia for the AI side, previously we said there are three buckets of AI, right?

subtitles.zh: 香港市场主要是下游应用，无论是互联网公司、大语言模型还是电动汽车。
subtitles.en: Hong Kong is mainly the downstream application, whether it's the internet companies or the LLMs or the EVs of the world.

subtitles.zh: 亚洲还有两类。一类是基础设施出口商，比如光模块、PCB、液冷等上游产品。
subtitles.en: Asia has two more buckets. One are the infrastructure exporters, right, optical transceivers, the PCBs, many of like the liquid cooling, the upstream stuff.

subtitles.zh: 但也有本地化标的，比如设备、存储、代工厂等。
subtitles.en: But there's also the localization names like the equipment, the memories, the fungries, right?

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为中国整体提供更多元化的选择。
subtitles.en: So, I do think China overall offers more diversification.

subtitles.zh: 尽管我们对出口商结构性更谨慎，但我认为某些国内本地化标的可能到了某个时点
subtitles.en: Even though we are structurally more cautious on the exporters, I think there should be a point where some of the domestic localization names

subtitles.zh: 会变得足够有吸引力，对吧？之前我们最大的担忧是估值，对吧？
subtitles.en: become interesting enough, right? Previously, our biggest concern is the valuation, right?

subtitles.zh: 因为其中一些标的的市盈率曾高达100倍。
subtitles.en: Because some of them were trading at like 100 times per year.

subtitles.zh: 现在，经过多方评级后，我认为人们仍在质疑一些基本面驱动因素，例如美国目前提出的MATCH法案，
subtitles.en: Now, after the multi-party rating, I think people are still questioning some of the fundamental drivers, for example, US is currently proposing this match act,

subtitles.zh: 这实质上要求盟友，比如荷兰、日本设备供应商，切断对中国现有已安装设备的维护服务，
subtitles.en: which is essentially requiring the allies, like, you know, the Dutches, the Japanese equipment suppliers to cut off the servicing of existing installed equipment in China,

subtitles.zh: 当然，还要停止供应先进芯片。
subtitles.en: and of course, to stop the supplying of advanced chips.

subtitles.zh: 如果发生这种情况，可能会对中国国内在设备产能和良率获取方面的本地化进展产生实际影响，对吧？
subtitles.en: And if that happens, it could have an active impact on China's domestic localization progress in terms of the access to equipment capacity yield, right?

subtitles.zh: 所以，我们仍需观察事态如何演变，对吧？
subtitles.en: So, we still need to figure out how does that evolves, right?

subtitles.zh: 你知道，X 将在年底左右，11月、12月进行投票。
subtitles.en: You know, the X will be up for voting toward the end of the year, November, December.

subtitles.zh: 所以，我们仍在关注一些事情，但我认为本地化在中国仍是一个良好的结构性故事，并且应该有一个估值变得足够便宜的点，

subtitles.en: that people should be bottom fish. Whereas Hong Kong, in the short term, might actually be defensive in the sense that it's under owned, it's value, it's cheap,

subtitles.zh: 而且香港市场的金融业仍是恒生指数的重要组成部分，对吧？
subtitles.en: and the Hong Kong market financial is still a big part of the HSI index, right?

subtitles.zh: 这可以给你一些支撑。一些大盘股，甚至消费类股，也有一定的收益率和增长。
subtitles.en: And that could give you some support. And some of the large cap, even the consumer's names, is also having some yield and go.

subtitles.zh: 所以，香港可能是一个短期的避风港，尤其是在大型科技互联网股遭遇抛售之后，

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.

subtitles.zh: 早上好，希望你一切顺利。你的预测是什么？为什么进入这个周末市场如此紧张？
subtitles.en: Good morning, and trust you're well. What's your prognosis? Why are markets so edgy going into this weekend?

subtitles.zh: 嗯，我们有很多不确定性，当问题无法回答时，市场参与者不喜欢这样。
subtitles.en: Well, we've had a lot of uncertainty, and investors don't like when questions can't be answered.

subtitles.zh: 所以我们对中期选举有很多担忧。
subtitles.en: So we had a lot of concern into the midterms.

subtitles.zh: 出现了蓝色浪潮，有点让人震惊。
subtitles.en: There was a blue tsunami, a little bit shocking to people.

subtitles.zh: 这引发了关于更多数据中心礼堂将会发生什么的疑问。
subtitles.en: That raises questions about what's going to happen in more auditoriums for data centers.

subtitles.zh: 而人工智能交易会有很多相关性。
subtitles.en: And the AI trade would have had a lot of correlation.

subtitles.zh: 这些都类似。七月期间大幅下跌，然后大幅反弹。
subtitles.en: That was all similar. There was a big drop in the July period, a big rebound.

subtitles.zh: 只是一波波的主题。软件某天下跌，半导体上涨，反之亦然。
subtitles.en: There have been just sort of waves and themes. Software is down one day, semis are up, and vice versa.

subtitles.zh: 所以有很多群体思维。不幸的是，这正在瓦解，因为一位有史以来最伟大的创始人离开了他经营的公司。
subtitles.en: So there's just a lot of a lot of groupthink. And unfortunately, this is unwinding because one of the greatest founders of all time has left the company that he ran.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为这给目前的看跌理由增添了额外的动力。
subtitles.en: So I think this has caused an extra, an extra dynamite in this bear case for the moment.

subtitles.zh: 但我认为最终会有解决方案。不过目前，我们对这些问题还没有太多答案。
subtitles.en: But I think there will be a resolution at some point. But at the moment, we don't have a lot of answers to these questions.

subtitles.zh: 即便在大型首秀中，我也无法忽视它。
subtitles.en: And even in a big debut, I can't drop it.

subtitles.zh: 不足以重振整个AI交易，亚当。
subtitles.en: Wasn't enough to revive this whole AI trade, Adam.

subtitles.zh: 我们能称这次IPO为成功吗？

briefs.current_title: 资管CIO Adam Gold：万亿IPO首日，普通配置者该追吗？

subtitles.zh: 这次IPO能算成功吗？对员工、创始人、风投来说，
subtitles.en: Can we call this IPO a success? A success for the employees, for the founders, and for the venture capitalists,

subtitles.zh: 以及对冲基金或共同基金，他们让这家公司从零市值到上市首日近2万亿美元，
subtitles.en: and the hedge funds or mutual funds who've taken this company from $0 in value to almost $2 trillion on day one,

subtitles.zh: 对其他没机会买入的市场参与者来说，不幸的是他们得等到IPO之后。
subtitles.en: unfortunate part for all the other investors who didn't have a chance to buy it, is they have to wait until this IPO comes out.

subtitles.zh: 这是过去十年私募市场的一个不幸之处。
subtitles.en: And this is an unfortunate part of the private markets in the last decade.

subtitles.zh: 我认为这些公司应该更早上市，SpaceX也是如此。
subtitles.en: These companies, I believe, should have been public much earlier, same thing for SpaceX for this.

subtitles.zh: 这样你才能真正有机会与所有市场参与者、人们的退休账户分享这些收益。
subtitles.en: And you have really got a chance to share those gains with all investors, people's retirement accounts.

subtitles.zh: 不幸的是，少数人控制了如此巨大的价值。
subtitles.en: And that's just unfortunate that they've controlled such a few people have held such this value.

subtitles.zh: 我认为这就是为什么一些AI领袖遭到很多反对，因为收益没有惠及所有人。
subtitles.en: And I think that's why there's actually a lot of backlash against some of the AI leaders, because it hasn't spread out to everyone.

subtitles.zh: 这很不幸。
subtitles.en: And that's unfortunate.

subtitles.zh: 是的，就像你把俱乐部大门对大多数人紧闭，然后早上30分才打开，最后狂欢一下。
subtitles.en: Yeah, it's almost like when you keep the doors to the club exclusive and close to most of the public, and then you open them up for 30 in the morning, and then you get this last hurrah.

subtitles.zh: 我想问的是，你会考虑参与吗？
subtitles.en: Which I guess is just my way of asking, would you buy into this?

subtitles.zh: 你会建议趁anthropic回调时参与吗？
subtitles.en: Would you be advising to buy into this dip on anthropic?

subtitles.zh: 或者应该等待多久？
subtitles.en: Or how long would one wait?

briefs.speaker_context: Chief Investment Officer at an investment advisory firm (referred to as Katam Hill)
briefs.current_title: 资管CIO Adam Gold：IPO首日不碰，等锁定期后再看

subtitles.zh: 或者要等多久？你的领先指标是什么，判断是否适合入场？
subtitles.en: Or how long would one wait? What would be your leading indicators, whether or not it is a good time to get into?

subtitles.zh: 举个例子，像Anthropic这样的名字，以及这次大规模亮相。
subtitles.en: That's an example, a name like anthropic, and this massive debut.

subtitles.zh: 当然，我从18岁起就专业从事这个行业。
subtitles.en: Sure, I've been doing this since I was 18 years old professionally.

subtitles.zh: 我现在43岁，有三个年幼的孩子。我在IPO上吸取了教训。
subtitles.en: I'm 43 now, I have three young children. And I've learned my lesson on IPOs.

subtitles.zh: 你要等到锁定期结束。锁定期会有分阶段释放，因为这里会像SpaceX那样分阶段进行。
subtitles.en: You wait until the lockups expire. There's explorations on lockups happen, because they're going to be more staged here like they were with SpaceX.

subtitles.zh: 我们不必精确等到180天，但你肯定想等到更多份额可用。
subtitles.en: We don't have to wait exactly till 180 days, but you certainly want to wait till more shares are available.

subtitles.zh: 私募市场是单边的。谁出价最高获得租赁所有权，就是谁。
subtitles.en: Private markets are one sided. It's whoever gives them the most money for the lease ownership.

subtitles.zh: 那等于报价估值。而这显然不真实。
subtitles.en: That equals the quote valuation. And that's clearly not true.

subtitles.zh: 估值基于双边市场，买方和卖方。
subtitles.en: A valuation is based upon two sided markets, buyers and sellers.

subtitles.zh: 所以我们不喜欢第一天就买入。我们很有耐心。
subtitles.en: So we don't like to buy on day one. We have a lot of patience.

subtitles.zh: 我们会等几个月，等到几次财报电话会议之后。
subtitles.en: We'll wait a few months. We'll wait till there's a few earnings calls.

subtitles.zh: 我们会看他们如何指引，看市场如何反应。
subtitles.en: We'll see how they guide. We'll see how the stock reacts.

subtitles.zh: 但我们不喜欢凭第一天的表现判断公司。
subtitles.en: But we don't like to judge companies on day one investments.

subtitles.zh: 我们喜欢以第十年的眼光判断，因此持有周期长达数十年。
subtitles.en: We like to judge them on year 10. And so we have a multi decade year holding period.

subtitles.zh: 那些是我们最青睐的公司，就像视频里的苹果。
subtitles.en: Those are our favorite companies, the ones like Apple on the video.

subtitles.zh: 我们持有这些公司已超过几十年，目标是继续寻找优质权益资产。
subtitles.en: We've owned those for over decades now. And our goal is to kind of continue to look for great investments.

subtitles.zh: 我们认为Anthropic未来可能成为一家伟大的复利型公司。
subtitles.en: We think anthropic might be a great compounding company in the future.

subtitles.zh: 有很多问题需要找到答案，但你知道，第一天就两万亿美元。
subtitles.en: There's a lot of questions that we'll have to get answers to. But you know, two trillion dollars on day one.

subtitles.zh: 我们对那种配置不感兴趣。
subtitles.en: We're not interested in that kind of investment.

subtitles.zh: 你提到你们持有某视频公司已有一段时间。
subtitles.en: You mentioned you've been holders of a video for some time now.

briefs.speaker: Adam Gold
briefs.speaker_context: Chief Investment Officer at an investment advisory firm (referred to as Katam Hill)
briefs.current_title: 资管CIO Adam Gold：AI龙头回调40%，为何仍不急于加仓？

subtitles.zh: 你提到你们持有某视频公司已有一段时间。在Jensen Wang相关事件后，你们是否调整了配置或敞口？
subtitles.en: You mentioned you've been holders of a video for some time now. Have you changed your allocation or your exposure to the stock since the fallout around Jensen Wang?

subtitles.zh: 是的，我们是长期持有者，自2016年起就相信AI。
subtitles.en: Yeah, we're very long term holders and believers in AI in 2016.

subtitles.zh: 当我在会议上遇到Jensen时，我问了他们关于AI的潜力。
subtitles.en: When I met Jensen at a conference, did I ask them about the potential of AI?

subtitles.zh: 以及半导体，那些将处理这种智能的机器。
subtitles.en: And the semiconductor, the machines that are going to process this intelligence.

subtitles.zh: 我们做了类比。我和他谈了PC时代的英特尔或超级计算时代的IBM。
subtitles.en: We made the analogy. I talked to him about Intel on the PC side or IBM on the super computing side.

subtitles.zh: 我们认为，实际上AI的潜力会比所有这些都大。
subtitles.en: And we thought, but actually AI would have bigger potential than all of that.

subtitles.zh: 因此，引领这场革命的公司可能成为世界上最大的公司。
subtitles.en: And so the company that would leave that revolution might be the biggest company in the world.

subtitles.zh: 这是在2016年，当时市值400亿美元。
subtitles.en: This has been in 2016 when it was a $40 billion market cap.

subtitles.zh: 当时它每季度总收入约10亿美元，全公司40亿美元。
subtitles.en: And at the time it was doing about a billion dollars quarter in total revenue, $4 billion for the whole company.

subtitles.zh: 目前营收运行率是4300亿美元。
subtitles.en: It's currently $430 billion revenue run rate.

subtitles.zh: 所以这些数字令人难以置信。实际上，没有人见过如此规模的公司以这样的速度增长。
subtitles.en: So the numbers are incredible. It's actually some no one's ever seen a company of this size grow at this pace.

subtitles.zh: 所以现在它的市盈率只有中个位数。
subtitles.en: So now it's trading at mid single digit PE multiple.

subtitles.zh: 你知道，所以它已经从高点下跌了40%。
subtitles.en: You know, so it's come down 40% from its high.

subtitles.zh: 你想想他们刚刚实现的70%、100%以上的营收增长率。
subtitles.en: And you think about the growth rate of 70, 100% plus revenue growth they just had.

subtitles.zh: 首席财务官现在以首席执行官的身份指引明年至少增长75%。
subtitles.en: The CFO now in terms CEO has guided to at least 75% next year.

subtitles.zh: 这是非常显著的增长。我认为，在回答你的问题之前，自2016年以来，我们已经总共减少了约75%的仓位。
subtitles.en: This is just remarkable growth. And I think until we have answers now to your question, over time since 2016, we've reduced our position by about 75% in total.

subtitles.zh: 由于复利效应，它仍然成长为我们的最大持仓。
subtitles.en: It still has grown to become our largest position in size just because of the compounding.

subtitles.zh: 但我们希望适时增持。
subtitles.en: But we would like to buy more of it in time.

subtitles.zh: 我们只需等待其中一些问题得到解答。我认为几周后的国会和参议院听证会将会很重要。
subtitles.en: We just have to wait for some of these questions to get answered. I think the congressional and Senate testimony in a few weeks will be important.

subtitles.en: Same industry. Bob Swan was a private equity investor.

subtitles.zh: 他们面临技术挑战，在AMD面前出现延迟。

subtitles.en: We're smoking with designers, engineers who work at software.

subtitles.zh: 半导体公司在软件和硬件方面都是如此。
subtitles.en: You know, semiconductor companies on software side, a hardware side.

subtitles.zh: 他们公开披露的路线图是三到六年。
subtitles.en: Their roadmap was three to six years in terms of publicly disclosed.

subtitles.zh: 内部应该翻倍，即六到十二年的内部开发进度。
subtitles.en: You should double that internally in terms of six to 12 years of how far out the internal development is going.

subtitles.en: And so the pipeline is very strong here. Publicly three to six years, privately six to 12 year roadmap.

current_title_lines: 核心业务为何反而更强？

subtitles.zh: 我们连线到了首席财务官Winston Chang，请他为我们解读这些数字，谈谈是什么导致了营业亏损或转为亏损。
subtitles.en: is a record joining us now. Of course, we have the CFO, Winston Chang. To walk us through these numbers, tell us about what drove that operating loss or what swung to a loss in some ways.

subtitles.zh: 这些是会计处理问题。目前市场对PC组件成本持续上升有些担忧。
subtitles.en: I mean, these are some counting issues. There are some concerns now about the PC component costs that are continued to store as well.

subtitles.zh: 这并不新鲜，很大程度上是由认股权证重估驱动的。
subtitles.en: Well, this is nothing new. This is really largely driven by the war and revaluation.

subtitles.zh: 在第三季度末，即自然年第三季度、但财年第二季度9月30日，股价非常高。
subtitles.en: At the end of a third quarter, a third quarter calendar year, but second quarter, September 30th, the stock price was very, very high.

subtitles.zh: 因此，按会计准则，认股权证重估产生了亏损。
subtitles.en: And therefore, the accounting war and valuation was a loss in terms of accounting standard.

subtitles.zh: 这笔调整达19亿美元。
subtitles.en: And that was a $1.9 billion adjustment.

subtitles.zh: 所以调整后，实际利润为14亿美元。
subtitles.en: So adjust the basis were actually $1.4 billion US dollars in terms of profits.

subtitles.zh: 营收同比增长48%，但各项利润——毛利润、营业利润——
subtitles.en: So revenue grew 48% year on year, but actually profit in every line of profit, growth profit, operating profit,

subtitles.zh: 以及净利润的增长都远快于营收增长。
subtitles.en: and net income profit grew much faster than revenue growth.

subtitles.zh: 这正是我们的目标。剔除所有复杂的会计处理，核心业务表现良好。
subtitles.en: And that's been our goal in terms of our target. So the core business is doing well when you strip out all the fancy accounting stuff.

briefs.speaker: Winston Chang
briefs.speaker_context: CFO, Lenovo
briefs.current_title: 联想CFO温斯顿：全年营收目标1000亿美元，上半年已超500亿

subtitles.zh: 撇开那些花哨的会计处理。相对而言，你们财年已过六个月，收入方面距离全年目标进展如何？
subtitles.en: out all the fancy accounting stuff. Relative to, so you're six months into your fiscal year, where are you relative to your full-year target as far as revenue goes?

subtitles.zh: 是的，我们有一个全年目标，嗯，我认为是两年目标超过1000亿美元。
subtitles.en: Yeah, we have a full-year target of, well, I think a two-year target of over $100 billion.

subtitles.zh: 今年上半年我们已经完成了超过500亿美元。
subtitles.en: We've already done greater than $50 billion in the first half of this year.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为我们正稳步推进该目标，而且本财年很可能超过1000亿美元的目标。
subtitles.en: So I think we're well on track of that goal and it's very likely that we'll exceed that goal of $100 billion in this current fiscal year.

subtitles.zh: 好的。好的。我是不是可以理解为你们可能需要上调指引？
subtitles.en: Okay. Okay. Do I sense that you'll need to maybe up, you know, raise it?

subtitles.zh: 现在上调指引？1000亿美元。
subtitles.en: Upgrade your guidance now? $100 billion.

subtitles.zh: 到什么时候你们会觉得，嗯，那将是轻而易举的事？
subtitles.en: At what point does it make sense for you to go, you know, that's going to be easy work now?

subtitles.zh: 嗯，内部来看，我们的基础设施业务同比增长了175%。
subtitles.en: Well, internally, you'll see that our infrastructure business grew 175% year on year.

subtitles.zh: 因此，鉴于全球计算需求依然强劲，该业务继续展现出强劲势头。
subtitles.en: And so that business continues to show a lot of strength, given that the global demand for compute remains robust.

subtitles.zh: 因此，基于这一点，我们实际上已经在内部上调了ISG业务的目标。
subtitles.en: And so on that basis, we've actually already internally adjust the target up for the ISG business.

briefs.speaker: Winston Chang
briefs.speaker_context: CFO, Lenovo
briefs.current_title: 联想CFO温斯顿：PC成本压力持续，基础设施业务如何对冲？
current_title_lines: 基础设施业务如何对冲？

subtitles.zh: 就PC市场持续的压力而言，您认为内存价格何时会见顶？您是否看到任何
subtitles.en: Yeah. In terms of just the ongoing PC headwinds, I mean, when do you think we're going to see, I mean, a cap when it comes to memory prices and then like, I mean, do you see anything

subtitles.zh: 可能以任何方式改变您的数字的因素？
subtitles.en: that could change the numbers in any way for you?

subtitles.zh: 对于PC业务？PC业务，我认为市场已经预期了大概超过六个月。
subtitles.en: For the PC business? The PC business, I think the market had been anticipating now for greater than probably six months.

subtitles.zh: 是的。所以大概在去年年底，一些行业报告已经预期到内存和其他组件成本上升
subtitles.en: Yeah. And so that's probably as end of last calendar year, I think this some of the industry reports had already anticipated with the greater memory and other component costs

subtitles.zh: 将导致销量下降。随着成本开始进入渠道，您开始看到这在市场中成为现实。
subtitles.en: that the volume will come down. And you're starting to see that come into fruition in the market as costs started coming into the channel.

subtitles.zh: 从设备业务的角度来看，我认为这可能会持续两到三个季度。
subtitles.en: And I think that will probably persist over the next two to three quarters from the device business perspective.

subtitles.zh: 是的，从设备业务的角度来看。对于组件成本。是的。
subtitles.en: Yeah, from the device business perspective. For component costs. Yeah.

subtitles.zh: 我们再谈一点。我们最喜欢的话题之一。是的，当然，当然。
subtitles.en: We talk a little bit more about that. One of our favorite topics. Yeah, of course, of course.

subtitles.zh: 但我认为我们在基础设施方面都受益，当然，有供应也有强劲需求。
subtitles.en: But I think we're getting benefits from both on the infrastructure side, of course, having the supply but with a strong demand.

subtitles.zh: 更高的成本确实是由业务基础设施方面的全球计算需求驱动的。
subtitles.en: The higher cost is really driven by the global compute on the infrastructure side of the business.

subtitles.zh: 我们在该领域拥有最优质的业务之一。
subtitles.en: And we have one of the best business in that area.

subtitles.zh: 对吧？我们的ISG业务在上季度成为X86服务器第一大供应商。
subtitles.en: Right? Our ISG business, we become the number one X86 server provider this last quarter.

subtitles.zh: 因此从这个角度看，我们拥有全球布局，且该业务收入实现三位数增长。
subtitles.en: So I think from that perspective, we are global footprint and our business growing in triple digits in terms of that revenue growth.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为该业务领域需求非常强劲。
subtitles.en: So I think a very strong demand in that side of the business.

subtitles.zh: 这很大程度上抵消了销量方面的下滑。
subtitles.en: More than more offsets that decline in terms of volume.

subtitles.zh: 谈论这些美国的新芯片限制可能会减缓AI发展，并影响中国的AI发展。
subtitles.en: Talk about these new chip curves in the US may actually slow down the AI development and affect AI development in China.

subtitles.zh: 你对此有何看法？我会从几个方面来分析。
subtitles.en: What's your take on all this? Well, I'll break it down into a couple of areas.

subtitles.zh: 一是全球对算力的需求。我认为这基本上没有改变。
subtitles.en: One is the global demand for compute. And I think that is very much intact.

subtitles.zh: Vidya的技术是市场上最好的之一。我认为它和其他供应商一样，在市场上仍有强劲需求。
subtitles.en: And Vidya's technology is one of the best in the market. I think that still has a strong demand in the market as with other suppliers.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为市场份额和其他方面在过去几周内没有变化。
subtitles.en: So I think there's a market share and other things have not changed in the course of last couple weeks.

subtitles.zh: 所以需求持续存在。就出现的其他复杂情况而言，我认为明确的监管实际上会更好
subtitles.en: So that demand continues. In terms of the other complexities that come out, I think clear regulations will actually be better

subtitles.zh: 从长远来看对市场更好，因为它实际上释放了资本，让有明确规则的人能够以合规的方式提供算力。
subtitles.en: for the market in the long run, because it actually frees up capital and allows people with clear rules to be able to provide compute in a compliant way.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为这实际上对我们这样非常合规的公司有帮助，但我们实际上不参与其他类型的交易。
subtitles.en: So I think it actually helps companies like us when we are very compliant, but we in fact don't get into other type of transactions.

subtitles.zh: 但规则明确时，我们就能通过运营方式合规。
subtitles.en: But when there's clear rules, then it complies through the way we operate.

subtitles.zh: 这对我们更有利。我认为这实际上释放了资本，因为许多银行也合规。
subtitles.en: It's even better for us. And I think that actually frees up capital, because a lot of banks are also compliant.

subtitles.zh: 因此，清晰度提高后，我认为资本得以释放，他们能向市场提供更多资金。
subtitles.en: So with clarity, I think the capital gets freed up in terms of what they can actually provide to the market.

subtitles.zh: 这是市场今天需要的。所以市场不仅在零部件方面受限，在资本方面也受限。
subtitles.en: That the market needs today. So not only the market is constrained in terms of components, but also constrained in terms of capital today.

subtitles.zh: 这些资本的成本正在重估，他们试图找到合适的资本成本。
subtitles.en: And that capital has a repricing in terms of that cost and they are trying to find the right cost of that capital.

subtitles.zh: 同时也在监管方面。
subtitles.en: But also in terms of the regulatory aspect.

subtitles.zh: 因此，清晰度提高后，我认为这也会释放资本配置。
subtitles.en: So with clarity, I think that will also frees up the capital deployment.

subtitles.zh: 服务器业务也可以再谈。因为很多人正在重新思考，我不确定行业预期是否准确，有多少资本支出投入其中。
subtitles.en: On the server business, we can go back to that as well. Because lots of people are rethinking, and I'm not sure if it's accurate on industry braces, how much catbex is going into this.

subtitles.zh: 从你的角度看，未来几年的增长态势如何？
subtitles.en: What are you seeing from your perspective in terms of just the build-up going into the next couple of years?

subtitles.zh: 是的。很多人在争论2028年的资本支出会怎样，因为超大规模企业的资本支出是争论焦点。
subtitles.en: Yeah. A lot of people are debating what will be the catbex in 2028 because the hyperscalers catbex is the debate

subtitles.zh: 2027年的情况很明确。我认为有很多讨论认为2028年仍将比2027年增长。
subtitles.en: and very clear in terms of 2027. I think there's a lot of discussions that that 2028 is still going to be an increase from 2027.

subtitles.zh: 好的。我们还看到下一梯队，不仅是你看到的美国或中国的超大规模企业。
subtitles.en: Okay. Well, we're also seeing in terms of the next tier, not only the hyperscalers that you see from the US or from China.

subtitles.zh: 你还看到下一级别的大型、超大型互联网公司，市值达数百亿美元。
subtitles.en: You're also seeing kind of the next level of large, very large internet companies in the double-digit billion market cap size.

subtitles.zh: 这类公司，可能不是万亿美元级别的，而是几千亿美元。
subtitles.en: That type of companies, and maybe not the trillion-dollar ones, but a couple hundred billion.

subtitles.zh: 规模足够大，他们也在部署，也在寻找计算空间和计算能力。
subtitles.en: Big enough that they are also deploying, and they're also looking for compute space and compute power.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为从这个角度看，你确实看到了健康的景象。
subtitles.en: So I think from that perspective, you were really seeing a healthy optic.

briefs.speaker_context: Head of APAC Equity Strategy, BofA Global Research
briefs.current_title: 美银Winnie：AI基建2026会重演光伏2022？出口双杀风险浮现

subtitles.zh: 当需求放缓时，产能仍在上线，这不仅是量的问题，也是均价的问题。
subtitles.en: Right, when the demand is slowing, well, cat-pack is still coming online, then it's not only a volume problem, it's also ASP problem.

subtitles.zh: 所以出口商可能面临双重打击：潜在的量放缓，以及定价压力。
subtitles.en: So, you know, exporters could start to face the double hit from both the outlook on potential volume slowdown, but it is also the pricing.

subtitles.zh: 国内最悲观的类比是，2026年的AI基础设施可能像2022年的光伏。
subtitles.en: So, domestically, the most bearish analogy is that AI infrastructure in 2026 might look like a solar trade in 2022.

subtitles.zh: 这是最极端的空头情景，对吧？
subtitles.en: Which is the ultimate bear case, right?

subtitles.zh: 所以出口实际上面临很多不确定性。
subtitles.en: So, export actually faced a lot of uncertainty.

subtitles.zh: 挑战在于，未来几个季度的盈利可能看起来还行，对吧？
subtitles.en: The challenges, next few quarters earning, might still look okay, right?

subtitles.zh: 如果看三四个季度，可能还行，但人们已经开始下调估值倍数，
subtitles.en: If you look at the three quarters, four quarters, might still be okay, but people already start to devalue the rate on the multiples,

subtitles.zh: 对某些板块来说，很难找到估值倍数的锚，比如我们之前讨论的存储。
subtitles.en: and for some of the sectors, it's really hard to find an anchor on the valuation multiple, like, you know, memory as we discussed before.

subtitles.zh: 你认为这更多是估值重估，还是基本面也出现了问题？
subtitles.en: Do you think this is more of a valuation reset, or do you think fundamentally there is something that is breaking down now, too?

briefs.speaker: Winnie
briefs.speaker_context: Head of APAC Equity Strategy, BofA Global Research
briefs.current_title: 美银Winnie：估值重估还是基本面破位？资金转向防御与下游

subtitles.zh: 你认为这更像是估值重估，还是基本面也出现了问题？
subtitles.en: Do you think this is more of a valuation reset, or do you think fundamentally there is something that is breaking down now, too?

subtitles.zh: 我认为两者都有。目前估值可能更多反映长期，而非下季度，
subtitles.en: I think it's both, right? As of now, valuation is reflecting probably more of the longer term, not next quarter,

subtitles.zh: 而是两到三年的大周期问题。
subtitles.en: but it's the two, three-year larger cycle question.

subtitles.zh: 因此，内需更大的市场，出口依赖较低，如日本、中国、印度，结构上更具优势，
subtitles.en: So, that's why we will say markets with a bigger domestic economy, less rely on export, you know, so the larger market, like, you know, Japan, China, India are structurally better position,

subtitles.zh: 至少有国内消费、金融板块和其他板块可布局，比如医疗保健，对吧？
subtitles.en: at least there's domestic consumption, there's financial sector, there's other sectors to play with, a health care, right?

subtitles.zh: 其次，总体而言我们倾向于防御，对吧？
subtitles.en: Second, I think generally we want to play defensive, right?

subtitles.zh: 因此，股息率高的权益资产很重要，某种程度上这就是为什么中国银行股现在成为共识增持，大家都喜欢，
subtitles.en: So, the dividend yield stocks are important, and to some extent that's why China banks are now, like, the consensus overweight, everyone loves China banks now,

subtitles.zh: 正如我们之前讨论的，不仅是股息率本身，还有每股股息的确定性，对吧？
subtitles.en: and as we discussed before, it's not only the dividend yield itself, but it's also the certainty of the DPS, right?

subtitles.zh: 银行股的优势在于其盈利确定性非常高。
subtitles.en: And the beauty of the banks has been that their earnings certainty is very, very high.

subtitles.zh: 因此，贝塔值低，防御性也很重要。
subtitles.en: So, beta is low, so the defensive part is also very important.

subtitles.zh: 但第三个要素，我认为人们正在考虑的是上游与下游的对比。
subtitles.en: But also, the third element, I think people are considering, is the upstream versus downstream.

subtitles.zh: 过去两三年，交易策略是围绕卖铲子的地方，对吧？
subtitles.en: All right, for the past two, three years, the trade is by the pick and shovel place, right?

subtitles.zh: 围绕上游基础设施，因为无论哪种模式胜出，他们都需要更多存储、更多冷却、更多PCB。
subtitles.en: By the upstream infrastructure, because regardless which model wins, they will need more memories, they will need more cooling, they will need more PCBs.

subtitles.zh: 但现在，担忧在于上游模式，其中一些可能终究没那么高，而且某些领域存在中国竞争，
subtitles.en: But now, the fear is that upstream, the mode, some of them might not be that high after all, and there's the Chinese competition in some of the sectors,

subtitles.zh: 产能已经建好，而大家一直低配一些下游，对吧？
subtitles.en: there's the capacity built out, whereas everyone has been underweight some of the downstream, right?

subtitles.zh: 从消费电子到应用类公司，所以也许人们正在寻求再平衡，对吧？
subtitles.en: Ranging from consumer electronics to the application names, so maybe people are looking to rebalance, right?

subtitles.zh: 中和上游基础设施的升级，并重新评估下游的故事。
subtitles.en: Neutralize the upgrade on the upstream infrastructure and looking to re-evaluate the downstream stories.

subtitles.zh: 问题是，如你所知，人们正试图弄清楚2028年的盈利情况。
subtitles.en: The issue is, as you know, people are trying to figure out what 20-28 earnings looks like.

briefs.current_title: 美银Winnie：英伟达比中国AI还便宜？明年中国能否跑赢

subtitles.zh: 有一件事我没料到，而且我认为大多数人今年也没预见到英伟达的故事，那就是按市盈率来看，英伟达现在实际上比中国还便宜。
subtitles.en: One thing I didn't expect, and I think most people didn't see the Nvidia story coming this year, was Nvidia is actually now cheaper than China when you look at it in a PE basis.

subtitles.zh: 说到这个，你认为明年中国能跑赢吗？
subtitles.en: On that note, do you think China can outperform next year?

subtitles.zh: 综合来看，有可能，是的。
subtitles.en: All things considered. Potentially, yeah.

subtitles.zh: 我的意思是，你知道，这又是相对的，也取决于中国的时机，或者是否有任何中国政策回应，对吧？
subtitles.en: I mean, you know, again, it's all relative, and it's also depending on the timing of China, or if there's any Chinese policy response, right?

subtitles.zh: 有可能，过去几年，出口支撑了中国的经济增长和数据等。
subtitles.en: Potentially, past a few years, export has hold up China's economic growth and data everything.

subtitles.zh: 如果明年我们面临更广泛的全球挑战，出口放缓，那么也许政策制定者会采取一些刺激措施。
subtitles.en: If next year we're facing a broader challenges globally, export is slowing down, then maybe policymakers will do something to stimulate.

subtitles.zh: 在这种情况下，按全年基础计算，明年中国可能跑赢。
subtitles.en: And in that case, in the full year basis, next year, China could outperform.

subtitles.zh: 温妮。
subtitles.en: Winnie.
